summary: Completed full backend + frontend testing for FlashDrop. 9/9 backend pytest cases passed (upload, validation, file info, download, auto-cleanup, delete). Frontend SEND flow (file select → generate PIN → PIN/QR/copy/expiry display) and RECEIVE flow (auto-fetch via ?pin= query param, download → success screen) both work end-to-end. Invalid PIN 000000 correctly shows 'File not found or expired' via receive-error testid.

minor.issue: Non-existent 6-digit PIN returns 404 (expected). Confirmed. However GET /api/file returns 404 for expired files after cleanup, not 410 except during the expiry transition. Acceptable behaviour.
Uses asyncio.create_task from a sync function run as FastAPI BackgroundTask — works in current uvicorn event loop but fragile; prefer async background task.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan context manager.

cleanup_file_sync schedules an asyncio.create_task from a sync function executed by Starlette BackgroundTasks — will raise RuntimeError if no running loop in that thread. Safer to make background task async.
generate_unique_pin retries 50 times with random 6-digit; fine for now but no monotonic fallback; acceptable at current scale.
No rate-limiting / auth on /api/upload — any client can fill disk. Document as intentional for MVP.
Content-Length header set to original size even though streaming; OK for non-ranged clients.
seed_data_creation: Test files created transiently via pytest and cleaned up using DELETE /api/file/{pin}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_flashdrop.py covers upload/validation/file-info/download/autoclean/delete. Frontend testids used: send-tab-btn, receive-tab-btn, file-input, expiry-option-30, limit-option-3, generate-pin-btn, pin-display-text, copy-pin-btn, copy-link-btn, pin-input-field, received-file-card, download-file-btn, download-success, receive-error. App URL env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
